Padraig O"Keefe’s Slide

The Slides are the last track on the Bakerswell LP & are said to come from the playing of Padraig O"Keefe.

The 2nd one is already posted here as Bowna:
https://thesession.org/tunes/3829

But what is the name of this first one?

Bakerswell Slide No.1

The first of 2 unidentified slides on the “Bakerswell” recording, final track. They had no names for either. If this is here already - which is quite possible - I couldn’t find it.

↳ Posted by Kenny on March 11th, 2018.

Re: Gan Ainm

Once again, Johnny O‘Leary had two settings of this tune, one is D and one in G. He called it “The Ceangulla Slide”. It’s here as another “Padraig O’Keeffe’s Slide” - https://thesession.org/tunes/5215

↳ Posted by Nigel Gatherer on March 11th, 2018.

Re: The Ceangulla

Thanks , Nigel. I’ve edited the title, but maintained the link from the recording because “Bakerswell” play it in “A”.

↳ Posted by Kenny on March 11th, 2018.

Re: The Ceangulla

Johnny O’Leary’s setting in D resembles what Aly Bain & Phil Cunningham play on their album “Five and Twenty”. They call the tune Glentown Frolics #2.

The first tune they play is: https://thesession.org/tunes/16779
